idea-plugin.name: Acrux Preview
idea-plugin.description: Live preview for Acrux UI views (.axaml / .xaml files in the Acrux XML namespace) of Space Engineers mods built on Acrux UI. The preview is rendered by the toolkit's preview host over Avalonia's remote previewer protocol; the edited file needs no Avalonia references. Preview hosting follows AvaloniaRider (MIT); see META-INF/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.
